mapper.select: select member_id, business_registration_file_key as document_url, application_status as status, rejection_reason, applied_at as created_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at from business_application where member_id = #{memberId} order by applied_at desc, business_application_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into business_application ( member_id, business_registration_file_key, application_status, applied_at ) values ( #{memberId}, #{documentUrl}, 'PENDING', now() ) on duplicate key update business_registration_file_key = values(business_registration_file_key), application_status = 'PENDING', applied_at = now(), reviewed_by = null, reviewed_at = null
